summary: [Slack] events: Events API: subscribe to bot events (message.channels/groups/im/mpim, app_mention, reaction_added/removed, member_joined_channel, file_shared, channel_created...); Slack POSTs signed JSON to Request URL. Alternative: Socket Mode over websocket with app-level token (no public URL; ~37k events/hr; unavailable for Marketplace apps). Deliveries include retry flags (X-Slack-Retry-Num/Reason): handlers must be idempotent.
